ud1.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud1.10:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bāhiyo dārucīriyo suppārake paṭivasati samuddatīre sakkato hoti garukato mānito pūjito apacito lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsana gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
ud1.10:1.4: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
ud1.10:1.5: ye kho keci loke arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataroti.
ud1.10:2.1: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa purāṇasālohitā devatā anukampikā atthakāmā bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena bāhiyo dārucīriyo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ etadavoca
ud1.10:2.2: neva kho tvaṃ bāhiya arahā nāpi arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpanno
ud1.10:2.3: sāpi te paṭipadā natthi yāya tvaṃ arahā vā assasi arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannoti.
ud1.10:3.1: atha ke carahi sadevake loke arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannāti.
ud1.10:3.2: atthi bāhiya uttaresu janapadesu sāvatthī nāma nagaraṃ
ud1.10:3.3: tattha so bhagavā etarahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
ud1.10:3.4: so hi bāhiya bhagavā arahā ceva arahattāya ca dhammaṃ desetīti.
ud1.10:4.1: atha kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo tāya devatāya saṃvejito tāvadeva suppārakamhā pakkāmi
ud1.10:4.2: sabbattha ekarattiparivāsena yena bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme tenupasaṅkami.
ud1.10:4.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū abbhokāse caṅkamanti.
ud1.10:4.4: atha kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo yena bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca
ud1.10:4.5: kahaṃ nukho bhante etarahi bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
ud1.10:4.6: dassanakāmamhā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
ud1.10:4.7: antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho kho bāhiya bhagavā piṇḍāyāti.
ud1.10:5.1: atha kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo taramānarūpo jetavanā nikkhamitvā sāvatthiṃ pavisitvā addasa bhagavantaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pāsādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamadamathasamathaṃ anuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yatindriyaṃ nāgaṃ
ud1.10:5.2: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pāde sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud1.10:5.3: desetu me bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ desetu sugato dhammaṃ
ud1.10:5.5: evaṃ vutte bhagavā bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ etadavoca
ud1.10:5.6: akālo kho tāva bāhiya antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhamhā piṇḍāyāti.
ud1.10:6.1: dutiyampi kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud1.10:6.2: dujjānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhante bhagavato vā jīvitantarāyānaṃ mayhaṃ vā jīvitantarāyānaṃ
ud1.10:6.4: desetu sugato dhammaṃ yaṃ mamassa hitāya sukhāyāti.
ud1.10:6.5: dutiyampi kho bhagavā bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ etadavoca
ud1.10:6.6: akālo kho tāva bāhiya antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhamhā piṇḍāyāti.
ud1.10:7.1: tatiyampi kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud1.10:7.2: dujjānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhante bhagavato vā jīvitantarāyānaṃ mayhaṃ vā jīvitantarāyānaṃ
ud1.10:7.4: desetu sugato dhammaṃ yaṃ mamassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
ud1.10:8.1: tasmā tiha te bāhiya evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
ud1.10:8.2: diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissatīti
ud1.10:8.4: yato kho te bāhiya diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati
ud1.10:8.9: tato tvaṃ bāhiya nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantare
ud1.10:9.1: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa bhagavato imāya saṅkhittāya dhammadesanāya tāvadeva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
ud1.10:10.1: atha kho bhagavā bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ iminā saṅkhittena ovādena ovaditvā pakkāmi.
ud1.10:10.2: atha kho acirapakkantassa bhagavato bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ gāvī taruṇavacchā adhipātetvā jīvitā voropesi.
ud1.10:11.1: atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ nagaramhā nikkhamitvā addasa bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ kālakataṃ
ud1.10:11.3: gaṇhātha bhikkhave bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa sarīrakaṃ mañcakaṃ āropetvā nīharitvā jhāpetha thūpañcassa karotha
ud1.10:12.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa sarīrakaṃ mañcakaṃ āropetvā nīharitvā jhāpetvā thūpañcassa karitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu
ud1.10:12.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
ud1.10:12.3: daḍḍhaṃ bhante bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa sarīraṃ thūpo cassa kato
ud1.10:12.5: paṇḍito bhikkhave dārucīriyo paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ na ca dhammādhikaraṇaṃ viheseti
ud1.10:13.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
